page.layout: One page of text in a single column; marginal notes at the right (Exo.20, 25, Deut. 27.5); handwritten annotations in the right margin are not printed and are left out. Running head at top with page number 125.

main_text.p: Moses seruus Iehouæ filiis Israel: sicut scriptum est in libro Legis Mosis, altare ex lapidibus integris, superquos nō Exo.20. 25. Deut. 27.5. leuauerant ferrum: & immolauerunt super illud holocausta Iehouæ, & sacrificauerunt hostias prosperitatum.
32 Scripsit quoque ibi in lapidibus repetitam Legem Mosis, quā scripsit coram filiis Israel.

33 Vniuersus autem Israel, & seniores eius, & præfecti, & Iudices eius stabant hinc & inde ad arcam coram sacerdotibus Leuitis portantibus arcam fœderis Iehouæ, tam peregrinus quam indigena: dimidia pars eius contra montem Garizin, & dimidia pars eius contra montē Ebal: quemadmodum præceperat Moses seruus Iehouæ, vt benedicer et populo Israel primùm.
34 Et posthæc legit omnia verba Legis, benedictionem & maledictionem secundum id totum quod scriptū est in libro Legis.

page.notes: Handwritten marginal annotations at right (not printed). Marginal references Exo.20. 25. and Deut. 27.5 are transcribed as printed; the second is set as "27.5" in the printed margin. Some words in the text are doubtful, e.g. "benedicer et" as printed.
